tools.name: due_services
tools.description: Work out which car maintenance services (oil, tires, brakes, filters, coolant, plugs, transmission, battery) are due, due soon or ok from the current odometer and optional service history, and name the next one. Use to check what a car needs now. Do NOT use for prices (use service_cost_estimate) or

tools.name: service_cost_estimate
tools.description: Estimate typical US parts-and-labor price ranges (USD) for a list of car maintenance services at an economy, mid or luxury shop, with low and high totals. Use when budgeting for known services. An estimate, not a quote. Do NOT use to find which services are due (use due_services).

tools.name: service_timeline
tools.description: Project the next 12 months of driving and list which maintenance services fall due in each month, from the odometer and monthly distance. Use when planning maintenance over the coming year. Do NOT use for what is due right now (use due_services) or prices (use service_cost_estimate).

tools.name: seasonal_checklist
tools.description: Generate a preventive car checklist for spring, summer, fall or winter, grouped by area (tires, battery, fluids, wipers and more) and tuned for a hot, cold or mixed climate. Use when getting a car ready for the season ahead. Do NOT use for mileage-based maintenance status (use due_services).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
